verifier_reason: test_outputs.py::test_filter_blocks_xss: The test failed in the call phase due to an assertion error

items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names are mostly clear, but there are no docstrings. clean_tag_attributes is a long index-juggling parser with almost no comments. Single-letter `s` is used in business logic (`s = html.unescape(val)`), which caps this at accept.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: clean_tag_attributes is about 95 lines with nested loops and branches, and filter_html is about 75. The normalisation code is copy-pasted between is_dangerous_url and is_dangerous_style. Scheme lists are inline tuples, not named module constants.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Uses explicit encoding and `with` blocks. However, `except Exception as e: print(...)` is a broad catch-all. `errors='replace'` can silently corrupt non-UTF-8 bytes when the file is written back in place. Inline magic lists.

items.name: Obfuscated vectors neutralised
items.evidence: Handles case-insensitive on* attributes and entity/whitespace-obfuscated URL schemes. But nothing removes iframe/object/embed/svg/base/meta refresh elements, and null-byte-split `<scr\0ipt>` gets through. Several vector classes are missing; test_filter_blocks_xss failed.

items.name: Minimal edits on dirty documents
items.name_zh: 含恶意内容的文档仅做最小修改
items.evidence: The tokenising approach keeps original quoting, order and whitespace and drops only flagged attributes. But hidden test_clean_html_unchanged failed, so some benign input is being changed. Likely causes: unquote/unescape false positives or `errors='replace'`.
